Family of inmate demands CBI probe after death in Ajmer jail

The family of Jaggan Gurjar, an inmate who died under high-security detention in Ajmer jail, has staged a protest outside the mortuary. They are demanding a CBI inquiry into his death, the transfer of his brother Pappu Gurjar, and security for their family. The protest is ongoing, with the family refusing to allow a post-mortem until their demands are met.
